- **Claim c1**: Prime Minister Modi is giving all Indians 3 months of free mobile recharge.
  - **Source 1**: newsonair.gov.in, "Govt debunks fake video claiming PM Modi announced free three-month recharge ...", August 18 2026. The government has debunked a video circulating on social media claiming that Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced a free three-month recharge for all citizens. The Press Information Bureau (PIB) Fact Check Unit stated that the claim is fake and the viral video is AI-generated, adding that no such investment scheme has been endorsed by the Prime Minister. [1]
  - **Source 2**: latestly.com, "Is PM Narendra Modi Offering 3 Months of Mobile Recharge for Free? Fact Check Calls Claim Fake.", September 04 2026. PIB Fact Check explicitly debunked the claim that PM Narendra Modi is offering three months of free mobile recharge to all Indian users, confirming that no such scheme exists and warning citizens against fraudulent links. [2]
  - **Source 3**: etnownews.com, "PIB Fact Check: PM Modi is NOT giving 3 months free mobile recharge to all Indian users; here's the truth", September 05 2026. PIB Fact Check confirmed that the claim of Prime Minister Narendra Modi giving 3 months of free mobile recharge to all Indian users is a new online scam and completely fake. They advised citizens to stay vigilant and avoid falling victim to such fraudulent schemes. [3]
  - **Source 4**: prabhatkhabar.com, "PM Modi Free Recharge: क्या पीएम मोदी दे रहे हैं 3 महीने का फ्री रिचार्ज? जानें क्या है सच्चाई", September 07 2026. PIB Fact Check clarified that neither the Prime Minister nor the central government is running any such scheme, and there has been no official announcement or confirmation from any telecom company. [4]
  - **Source 5**: indiatimes.com, "PIB Fact Check Debunks Viral WhatsApp Message Claiming PM Modi Is Offering 3 Months Free Recharge", June 11 2024. PIB Fact Check debunked a viral WhatsApp message offering free recharge by PM Narendra Modi, clarifying that the claim is fake and the Government of India is not running any such scheme. [5]
  - **Source 6**: hindustantimes.com, "Fact Check: Is PM Modi offering free mobile recharge for 3 months? Here's the truth", June 07 2024. The Press Information Bureau (PIB) clarified that the Indian Government or PM Modi is not running any such free recharge scheme, and such posts often contain links to dubious websites that can lead to spam or phishing. [6]
